_comment: Fixed scenario set for scripts/token-bench.mjs (Phase 1 P17). Version 3.
Version 3 = the seven version-2 scenarios, UNCHANGED, plus six added ones (agent-kit K1 T0.2).
`compatibleWith: [2]`: a version-2 baseline still covers its own seven scenarios; the new
ones show as "new" until a version-3 baseline is committed.
Every sample opens a NEW v2 chat (one chat per scenario sample; every turn of
a multi-turn scenario reuses that chat). The bench reseeds its temp workspace
before each sample (notes.txt ~10 KB, data/part-1..3.txt ~10 KB each).
`mode` is sent explicitly; an auto mode is refused unless the scenario sets
`classifier: true` (auto-mode: the classifier is the thing measured). In a --fake run
such a turn is sent as `ask` (the fake engine has no classifier seam and the real one
is a paid call). Classifier and memory-extraction calls are reported as helperBillableTokens /
helperCalls beside the billable tokens, not inside them.
`turnModes`: one explicit mode per turn (mode-switch).
`dropSessionBefore`: turn indexes before which the chat's SDK session is deleted and the turn
is sent fresh with the chat's history (ended-chat-continue; what the Mac sends after a restart).
`fakeMcp`: N stub stdio MCP servers (scripts/bench-fixtures/fake-mcp-server.mjs) are registered,
consented and enabled for the bench user for the scenario's samples (mcp-two-servers).
`expectTools`: the scenario should make at least one tool round trip (hops > 1).
A real run fails when it does not; a --fake run only warns.
Change a prompt, a seed file or this file's version only together with a new
token-baseline.json. Bump `version` on any such change.
